text: Zombies won't kill you first. The crowd will.
Saturday, 8 PM. The mall is packed. Thousands of people inside.
say: Saturday, eight P.M. The mall is packed. Thousands of people inside.

text: Then someone screams near the entrance.
A man lunges at the guard. Then another one.
Within 10 seconds, everyone's running... straight for the main entrance.
say: Within ten seconds, everyone's running... straight for the main entrance.

text: That's your brain. When you're scared, you go back the way you came in. Even if that's where the danger is.
stat: in fires, people run for the door they came in

text: Others stop moving. 3 in 4 people freeze.
say: Others stop moving. Three in four people freeze.
stat: freeze in the first moments of a disaster

text: The doors jam. People push, people go down.
And all that screaming... that's what they follow.

say: Rule one: don't follow the crowd.

text: 2: look for the fire exit, not the entrance.
say: Two: look for the fire exit, not the entrance.

text: 3: stay quiet. They hunt by sound.
say: Three: stay quiet. They hunt by sound.

text: While everyone fights for the front doors... you take the one nobody's looking at.
But in a fire or a stampede... your brain does the exact same thing.
So the next time you walk into a mall... find the fire exit first.
